patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts for feature sections, alternating image and text positions to maintain visual interest and balance.
Elegant serif headings are consistently paired with clean sans-serif body text, establishing a sophisticated yet highly readable typographic hierarchy.
A warm, earthy color palette of off-whites, light beiges, and a prominent peach/orange accent is used throughout, conveying a natural and approachable wellness aesthetic.
Scroll-triggered fade-up and slide-in animations are applied to content blocks and individual elements as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging reveal experience.
An interactive 'What brought you here today?' section directly addresses common user problems with clickable cards, serving as a soft lead qualification and problem-identification tool.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations are used to progressively reveal content as the user scrolls down the page. Sections and individual elements appear with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye through the content. This effect is consistent across the site, likely implemented using an Animate On Scroll (AOS) library.

The site employs a sophisticated typographic pairing of an elegant serif font for prominent headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and UI elements, establishing a premium and editorial feel.
Interactive cards are used to present user problems, allowing users to self-identify with relevant issues and potentially leading them to specific product solutions or information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Moderately sized serif headings (~2-3x body) with clean sans-serif body text and uppercase sans-serif labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners for buttons and input fields, sharp for most other elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and comfortable line-heights within text blocks.

standout: The distinctive combination of an elegant, editorial serif typeface for headings with a warm, earthy color palette creates a sophisticated and trustworthy brand identity for a wellness product, moving beyond typical clinical or overly minimalist designs. The interactive 'What brought you here today?' section is also a clever way to engage users and understand their needs.
